issue: Mutable default list is shared across all calls and grows without bound.
Identity comparison against a string literal can silently fail; use ==.
Tax is computed on the original price instead of the discounted price.
File handle is never closed; use a with block.
A full cache is cleared entirely instead of evicting an entry.
The caught exception is discarded, so raise last raises None and loses the error.
Read-modify-write is not protected by the lock, so increments race.
